complexity.notes: Using valid *= isValidLine(...) relies on bool/int coercion and is less readable than valid = valid and isValidLine(...) or valid &= .... The count-based duplicate check is O(L^2) per line (still constant here); a set-based check would be cleaner. Also, the eager evaluation means all 27 lines are checked even after a failure is found.
complexity.summary: Checks every row, column, and 3x3 box for duplicate digits by calling list.count for each cell, treating each unit as a 'line' to validate. The board is fixed at 9x9, so all work is constant time.
